title: CI real-conflict request (POST <BASE>/ci/conflict)
description: Sent by a pipeline (project token) when a rebase or a merge actually produced a conflict. Lets the backend record whether it saw the collision coming (wasDetected) — the protocol measures its own misses. Missing required fields → HTTP 400 {"error": ...}. Answer: {ok, conflictId, wasDetected}.

issueKey.description: Ticket key of the branch that hit the conflict. REQUIRED.

paths.description: Conflicted paths, repo-relative: an array of strings, or one string with one path per line. REQUIRED, non-empty.

withIssueKey.description: Ticket key of the other side of the conflict, when known.
